title: Hall algebras of graphs and rooted trees
summary: Hall algebras can be associated with a broad class of combinatorial structures through the theory of 2-Segal sets. In this paper, we study the Hall algebras arising from the 2-Segal sets of rooted trees, undirected graphs, and directed graphs. In each case, we establish an analogue of Green's theorem giving a twisted bialgebra structure to the Hall algebra, describe the primitive elements, and derive a presentation by generators and relations.
